title: Textile & Apparel
summary: Textile production spans from fiber to finished goods and requires continuous data flow across spinning, weaving, dye-house, and apparel processes.

needs.title: Batch traceability
needs.description: Track fiber to yarn to fabric to finished goods with roll-level genealogy.

needs.title: Dye recipe verification
needs.description: Validate vessel recipe, dosing, and color standard targets.

needs.title: Energy and steam/water monitoring
needs.description: Measure electricity, gas, steam, and water usage in dye-house operations.

needs.title: Lot-based quality control
needs.description: Maintain defect maps, quality grades, and rejection records by fabric roll.

needs.title: Operator and shift performance
needs.description: Monitor production and scrap trends by machine, operator, and shift.

solutions.title: OnSuite Connect
solutions.description: Collect data from weaving, knitting, dye-house PLCs, and machine controllers.

solutions.title: OnSuite Trace
solutions.description: Traceability at batch, vessel, and fabric-roll levels.

solutions.title: OnSuite Live + Optima
solutions.description: Machine-level dashboards, OEE tracking, and MTBF analytics.

solutions.title: OnSuite Energy
solutions.description: Electricity, gas, steam, and water monitoring for dye-house lines.

solutions.title: OnSuite Forms (DSF)
solutions.description: Digital quality forms, shift handover records, and inspection checklists.

solutions.title: Recipe and document governance
solutions.description: Centralized control of dye recipes, color standards, and customer specifications.

results.title: Improved color consistency
results.description: Recipe validation increases first-pass color matching performance.

results.title: Energy and steam savings
results.description: Visible consumption patterns reveal inefficiencies in dye-house operations.

results.title: Roll-level traceability
results.description: Customer complaints can be traced back at fabric-roll granularity.

results.title: More reliable order fulfillment
results.description: Order status and bottlenecks become instantly visible.

results.title: Sustainability reporting readiness
results.description: Water, energy, and carbon data can be reported for brand customers.
